name: cta-banner
description: Full-width call-to-action banner with headline, description, and prominent button for conversion

ai.whenToUse: Use between content sections or near the bottom of a page to drive a specific action. Best for trial signups, newsletter subscriptions, demo requests, or any page that needs a prominent conversion point.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use at the very top of a page (use a hero instead). Avoid stacking multiple CTA banners — one per page is ideal.

description.description: Supporting text that reinforces the value proposition
description.example: Join thousands of teams who ship faster with our platform.
